rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches codebase conventions, correctly utilizing the existing git.Client patterns and refactoring shared logic cleanly.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles all edge cases, including blank worktree paths, mutually exclusive flags, path normalisation, and proper branch checkout/sync logic.
rationale.scope: Strictly adheres to the requirement, modifying only the necessary files and removing redundant code (e.g., localBranchExists).
rationale.readability: Clear structure and descriptive variable names; comments explain worktree logic well.
rationale.robustness: Safely handles paths with spaces through string arrays, properly manages context, and handles command failures safely.
rationale.maintainability: Extracts shared worktree functions into a dedicated package and unifies the git worktree command execution cleanly.
